:= by
  have h_factors : (a, b) ∈ {(4, 3), (6, 2), (12, 1)} := 
    begin
      rcases h with ⟨n, m⟩,
      refine (set.mem_insert_self (6, 2) _).or_right (set.mem_insert_self (12, 1) _).or_right (set.mem_insert_self (4, 3) _).or_right,
      exact set.mem_set_of_eq
    end
  have h_valid : (a, b) ≠ (6, 2) ∧ (a, b) ≠ (12, 1) :=
    begin
      constructor,
      { contrapose! hb,
        rw [not_lt],
        apply Nat.le_of_gt,
        exact hb },
      { contrapose! ha,
        rw [not_lt],
        apply Nat.le_of_gt,
        exact ha }
    end
  have h_only : (a, b) = (4, 3) :=
    begin
      rcases h_factors with (h1 | h2 | h3),
      { exact false.elim (h_valid.1 h1) },
      { exact false.elim (h_valid.2 h2) },
      { exact h3 }
    end
  exact eq.symm h_only
